# Event Intelligence — documentation for coding agents and LLMs

> Host-neutral published v1.0.0 SDK for durable future conditions, event-time
> correlation, source provenance and targeted wakeups; not an LLM runner.

Package: `mcp-event-intelligence` (Node.js >=22).
Current published stable release: `mcp-event-intelligence@1.0.0` (Node.js >=22), published to npm `latest` and MCP Registry on **2026-11-11**. Pin exact consumer versions and review stored-state migration before upgrading from an older channel. The `0.12.0-next.1` prerelease is historical.

This file is a convenience index only. It is not an MCP endpoint, an
agent-executable configuration or a guarantee that arbitrary LLM clients
will auto-discover the repository.
